title: On the Road With Ukraine’s Refugees

sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: In response to Russia's increasingly brutal campaign against Ukrainian towns and cities, an estimated 1.5 million people, most of them women and children,
sentences.zh: 为了应对俄罗斯针对乌克兰城镇日益残酷的军事行动，据估计，在过去10天里，约有150万人（其中大多数是妇女和儿童）

sentences.en: have fled Ukraine over the past 10 days, the fastest displacement of people in Europe since World War II.
sentences.zh: 逃离了乌克兰，这是自二战以来欧洲发生的最快的人口流离失所事件。

sentences.en: Today, Sabrina Tabernese traveled alongside them as they made their escape.
sentences.zh: 今天，萨布丽娜·塔伯内斯跟随他们一起踏上了逃亡之路。
我们正在离开酒店房间。

sentences.en: on Tuesday, and we're leaving the hotel room in Kyiv, walking through a very dark hallway to an elevator that will bring us down to the car, where we will drive south and weSt.
sentences.zh: 周二，我们正离开基辅的酒店房间，穿过一条非常昏暗的走廊，走向电梯，电梯将带我们下到车旁，然后我们将向南和向西行驶。

sentences.en: Last Tuesday, the New York Times made the decision to pull a group of reporters out of Kyiv and bring them to a city in western Ukraine that was safer called Lviv.
sentences.zh: 上周二，《纽约时报》决定将一组记者撤出基辅，带到乌克兰西部一个更安全的城市，名叫利沃夫。

sentences.en: I was one of those reporters, and so was my colleague, Valerie Hopkins.
sentences.zh: 我是其中一名记者，我的同事瓦莱丽·霍普金斯也是。

sentences.en: The drive was supposed to take seven hours.
sentences.zh: 这段车程本应需要七个小时。

sentences.en: Instead, it took us two days and two nights.
sentences.zh: 结果，我们花了整整两天两夜。

sentences.en: And just as we closed the trunk in the parking lot of the hotel, we heard this huge bang, and then another.
sentences.zh: 就在我们在酒店停车场关上后备箱时，我们听到了巨大的爆炸声，接着又是第二声。

sentences.en: We just heard some artillery, unclear if it's incoming or outgoing.
sentences.zh: 我们刚听到了一些炮火声，不清楚是打进来的还是打出去的。

sentences.en: We got into the car and drove out, and some ambulance is driving by.
sentences.zh: 我们上了车开走，旁边有一辆救护车经过。

sentences.en: Later, we would discover that those two booms were Russian military trying to blow up the television tower in downtown Kyiv.
sentences.zh: 后来我们发现，那两声巨响是俄罗斯军队试图炸毁基辅市中心的电视塔。

sentences.en: The truck, the traffic lights have stopped working.
sentences.zh: 交通灯已经停止工作了。
这真的、真的很令人难过。

sentences.en: We're just driving through an intersection where there are some very serious-looking barricades.
sentences.zh: 我们正开车穿过一个路口，那里有一些看起来非常严肃的路障。

sentences.en: A bunch of sandbags and probably a couple of dozen men in black uniforms walking across the street holding rifles.
sentences.zh: 一堆沙袋，还有大约两打身穿黑色制服、手持步枪的男人走过街道。

sentences.en: After driving down those back roads out of Kyiv, under that really dark, low sky, we stayed in the town of Bielad Sirkva.
sentences.zh: 在沿着基辅郊外那些小路行驶，穿过那片阴沉、低垂的天空后，我们在别拉亚采尔科夫镇停留了一晚。

sentences.en: And we were woken up by another enormous boom.
sentences.zh: 我们被另一声巨大的爆炸声惊醒了。

sentences.en: We kept driving that next day.
And we thought we'd pretty easily be in Lviv by dinnertime.
sentences.zh: 我们本以为到晚饭时间就能轻松抵达利沃夫。

sentences.en: But we just kept getting stuck.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直被堵在路上。

sentences.en: I mean, it was checkpoint after checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是一个接一个的检查站。
车流拥挤得令人难以置信。

sentences.en: And we're in a line of cars, as far as the eye can see, on the highway going west toward the Wolf from Wienica.
sentences.zh: 我们正排在高速公路上，一眼望不到头的车队正向西驶向文尼察。

sentences.en: Everybody has cars packed with kids, animals, suitcases.
sentences.zh: 每个人的车里都塞满了孩子、宠物和行李。

sentences.en: A woman holding a little boy just waved at me.
sentences.zh: 一位抱着小男孩的女士刚才向我挥了挥手。

sentences.en: Lots of cars with handmade signs in the window, taped to the windows, saying,
sentences.zh: 很多车的窗户上都贴着手写的标语，上面写着：

sentences.en: children, it's just stretched on for miles and miles and miles, just going slowly, maybe five kilometers an hour.
sentences.zh: “孩子”，车队绵延数英里，行进速度非常缓慢，可能每小时只有五公里。

sentences.en: And we're kind of neck and neck, so I'm going to stick my head out the window here and see if someone will talk to me.
sentences.zh: 我们的车并排停着，所以我打算把头伸出窗外，看看有没有人愿意跟我聊聊。

sentences.en: Я из газеты New York Times, и меня зовут Сабрина.
sentences.zh: 我来自《纽约时报》，我叫萨布丽娜。
他来自克罗皮夫尼茨基。

sentences.en: We've been driving for six hours now.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开了六个小时了。

sentences.en: И дети, дети садят там, да?
sentences.zh: 还有孩子，孩子们坐在后面，对吧？

sentences.en: His name is Valery and he has little kids in the back.
sentences.zh: 他叫瓦列里，后座有几个小孩。

sentences.en: А как вы себе чувствуете сейчас, Валерий?
sentences.zh: 瓦列里，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Подавлю, потому что семья уедет, а я останусь.
sentences.zh: 很压抑，因为家人要走了，而我得留下来。

sentences.en: I'm really feeling quite down because my family is going out and I'm going to need to stay.
sentences.zh: 我感觉非常沮丧，因为我的家人要离开，而我必须留下来。

sentences.en: А что произошло в вашем городе, когда вы уехали?
sentences.zh: 你们离开时，你们城市发生了什么？

sentences.en: Ну, я из Одессы, а был в Кировограде.
sentences.zh: 我来自敖德萨，但当时在基洛沃格勒。

sentences.en: А в Одессе начали уже врывы.
sentences.zh: 敖德萨已经开始发生爆炸了。

sentences.en: I was in Odessa before, and Odessa, there are already explosions starting in Odessa.
sentences.zh: 我之前在敖德萨，那里已经开始发生爆炸了。

sentences.en: А какие чувства у вас есть сейчас в сердце, именно сейчас?
sentences.zh: 你现在内心是什么感受，就在此刻？

sentences.en: He's saying, what are your feelings in your...
What are your feelings in your heart right now, right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在内心到底是什么感受？

sentences.en: And they sit very, very heavy, very pressed down.
sentences.zh: 他们感到非常沉重，非常压抑。

sentences.en: And his wife is starting to cry.
Я из газеты New York Times.
А сколько вы уже в этом трафике?
sentences.zh: 你们在车流里堵了多久了？
我们前天从切尔尼戈夫出发的。

sentences.en: Oh, they left the day before yesterday.
Потому что устал сидеть в погребе.
sentences.zh: 因为厌倦了坐在地窖里。

sentences.en: Мы были очень tired of sitting in the basement in a coffin.
sentences.zh: 我们厌倦了坐在地窖里，像在棺材里一样。

sentences.en: There, above my house, was a war going full force.
sentences.zh: 就在我家上方，战争全面爆发了。

sentences.en: Они не ели уже несколько дней некоторые.
sentences.zh: 有些人已经好几天没吃东西了。

sentences.en: Старики остались высоко на этажах и не могут помочь.
sentences.zh: 老人们被困在高层楼里，没人能帮他们。

sentences.en: The old people are stuck in the houses.
Tell them to stop what's happening.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们停止正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: If you can tell somebody, just communicate this.
sentences.zh: 如果你能告诉任何人，请传达这一点。

sentences.en: You have to stop this somehow.
sentences.zh: 你们必须以某种方式阻止这一切。

sentences.en: They told us it was mined.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们那里被埋了地雷。

sentences.en: Please, please tell them to stop it.
sentences.zh: 求求你，求求你告诉他们停止这一切。

sentences.en: There were lots of moms consoling children.
sentences.zh: 有很多母亲在安慰孩子。

sentences.en: Sitting on their lap, sitting in the back, playing with toys.
sentences.zh: 坐在她们膝盖上，坐在后座，玩着玩具。

sentences.en: One little baby had a stuffed mobile hung above her head, made of cloth mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 有个小婴儿的头顶挂着一个毛绒玩具，是用布做的蘑菇。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter from the New York Times.
Yeah, I'll have a second, of course.
sentences.zh: 好的，我有时间，当然可以。

sentences.en: Everybody talked about what it was that pushed them to actually go.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在谈论是什么促使他们最终决定离开。

sentences.en: There were so many explosions last night.
And for the most part, it was explosions.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间都是爆炸声。

sentences.en: So we're trying to get somewhere that is safe.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正试图去一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: Children feeling terrified, having to go down into basements all the time.
sentences.zh: 孩子们感到恐惧，不得不一直躲进地窖。

sentences.en: And parents just decided they'd had enough.

sentences.zh: 距离堵车路段还有两小时车程。
我们终于到达检查站了。

sentences.en: By the end of the day on Wednesday, it became pretty clear that we were never going to make it to Lviv that night.
sentences.zh: 到了周三快结束时，很明显我们当晚是赶不到利沃夫了。

sentences.en: It was already getting dark, and we needed to stop for the night.
sentences.zh: 天已经黑了，我们需要找个地方过夜。

sentences.en: And we were calling everywhere, any hotel, and everything was full.
sentences.zh: 我们到处打电话，问了所有的酒店，但都住满了。

sentences.en: And at some point, my colleague, Valerie, reached someone in a town called Vitovtsi, who said there was actually space at a kindergarten in their town.
sentences.zh: 后来，我的同事瓦莱丽联系到了维托夫齐镇的一个人，他说他们镇上的一所幼儿园里其实有空位。

sentences.en: And it didn't seem like a great option, but it was dark, and it was snowing.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不是个好选择，但当时天已经黑了，还在下雪。

sentences.en: And at that point, we didn't have a better idea.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我们也没有更好的主意了。

sentences.en: So we drove to the town.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开车去了那个镇子。

sentences.en: And we got out, and a man greeted us and introduced himself as the mayor of the town.
sentences.zh: 我们下车后，一位男士迎接了我们，并自我介绍说是镇长。

sentences.en: And he said we just needed to bring our passports up to the second floor, register, and then we could have the room in the kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 他说我们只需要把护照带到二楼登记，然后就可以住进幼儿园的房间了。

sentences.en: They took us into the kindergarten, and it was this.
sentences.zh: 他们带我们进了幼儿园，就是这个样子。

sentences.en: Oh, we're in a kindergarten, and there's a little, oh, there's little cubbies.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们在幼儿园里，这里有小小的，噢，有小储物柜。

sentences.en: Really brightly painted series of rooMs.

sentences.zh: 小储物柜，儿童尺寸的小椅子。

sentences.en: There's a painting of a giraffe and a palm tree on the wall.
sentences.zh: 墙上画着长颈鹿和棕榈树。

sentences.en: And a lot of spider plants.
And lots of little child-sized mattresses.
sentences.zh: 还有很多儿童尺寸的小床垫。
奥克萨娜正在带我们看厨房。

sentences.en: So we started to settle in for the night, and a very kind woman who ran the kindergarten made food for us.
sentences.zh: 我们开始安顿下来过夜，经营这家幼儿园的一位非常善良的女士为我们做了吃的。

sentences.en: She made us spicy rice with chicken.
And she had a huge jar of pickles that she had made herself, that she brought out, and we each took a pickle.
sentences.zh: 她还拿出一大罐她自己腌的酸黄瓜，我们每人拿了一根。

sentences.en: We had dinner at a tiny little child-sized table, sitting on tiny little child-sized chairs.
sentences.zh: 我们在小小的儿童桌旁，坐在小小的儿童椅上吃了晚餐。

sentences.en: Asking if this is the other family.
sentences.zh: 问问这是不是另一家人。

sentences.en: Can I have to say hello?
And pretty soon another family showed up.
So Luda is grandmother, and then three grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 所以卢达是祖母，还有三个孙辈。

sentences.en: Oh, we were driving for 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们开了12个小时的车。

sentences.en: They came from Cerkassi, a little bit below.
sentences.zh: 他们来自切尔卡瑟，在下面一点。
那么，切尔卡瑟发生了什么？

sentences.en: It was a hit or something?
sentences.zh: 是被袭击了吗还是什么？

sentences.en: I'm saying what happened in Cerkassi, and they're saying explosions.
sentences.zh: 我在问切尔卡瑟发生了什么，他们说有爆炸。

sentences.en: What was a hit to leave?
sentences.zh: 什么袭击导致你们离开？

sentences.en: How did you decide to leave?
sentences.zh: 你们是怎么决定离开的？

sentences.en: My family was living in Poland.
And my mom was calling every day.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈每天都打电话来。

sentences.en: The truth is, I would actually like to stay.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我其实想留下来。

sentences.en: I think I would be helpful in some way.
But my mom, I mean, I want to be with her.
sentences.zh: 但我妈妈，我是说，我想和她在一起。

sentences.en: Really, I want to be with her.
And Ira, what are you feeling right now in your heart?
sentences.zh: 伊拉，你现在心里是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I was driving in the car and started to cry because I understand that I'm just running from my country from my country.
sentences.zh: 我在开车的时候开始哭，因为我明白我只是在逃离我的国家，逃离我的国家。

sentences.en: I was going in the car and I was feeling like I was going to cry because I felt like I was leaving my country and it was actually war.
sentences.zh: 我在车里的时候，感觉快要哭出来了，因为我觉得我正在离开我的国家，而这确实是战争。

sentences.en: And I was leaving my country.
It's a really horrible feeling, actually.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真的很糟糕，真的。

sentences.en: It's a really horrible feeling, actually.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真的很糟糕，真的。

sentences.en: My boyfriend actually went to do the man the checkpoints and that can be a dangerous thing in town to man the checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 我男朋友去守检查站了，在城里守检查站可能很危险。

sentences.en: He stayed there and he won't leave.
He stayed there and he won't leave.
On one hand, I'm really proud.
On the other hand, I was trying to convince him not to do it.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我曾试图说服他不要去。

sentences.en: Luda is offering us little pancakes with meat and they're so good.
sentences.zh: 卢达在请我们吃小肉饼，味道真好。

sentences.en: While we were there standing in the kindergarten talking, a woman walked in.
sentences.zh: 当我们站在幼儿园里聊天时，一位女士走了进来。

sentences.en: She owned a hotel right down the street.
sentences.zh: 她在街那头开了一家酒店。

sentences.en: And she told us it was overflowing.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们酒店已经住满了。

sentences.en: Lots of people are sleeping, so we're going to try to not make a lot of sound.
sentences.zh: 很多人在睡觉，所以我们要尽量小声点。

sentences.en: She took us to her hotel.
sentences.zh: 她带我们去了她的酒店。

sentences.en: And when we went inside, we saw people lying everywhere.
sentences.zh: 当我们进去时，看到到处都躺着人。

sentences.en: There's a man who's sleeping in the corridor.
sentences.zh: 走廊里有个男人在睡觉。

sentences.en: This is another little place for sleeping, underneath a piano.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个睡觉的小地方，在钢琴底下。

sentences.en: So Armin is showing me where they're going to be sleeping.
sentences.zh: 阿明正在带我看他们要睡的地方。

sentences.en: In a back room that was very small.
sentences.zh: 在一个非常小的后屋里。

sentences.en: Sometimes it feels like it just is an old movie that you're watching in front of your eyes.
sentences.zh: 有时感觉就像在看一部发生在眼前的老电影。

sentences.en: Armin is saying, come in, come in, welcome.
sentences.zh: 阿明在说，进来，进来，欢迎。

sentences.en: You're going to sleep under the table.
It's two women and a young child who just came through the door.
sentences.zh: 那是两个女人和一个刚进门的小孩。

sentences.en: And suddenly we heard these air raid sirens.
sentences.zh: 突然我们听到了空袭警报。

sentences.en: Hey, Valerie, where are you going?
And everyone in the hotel moved toward a trap door in the floor and climbed down into the basement.
sentences.zh: 酒店里的每个人都朝地板上的活板门走去，爬进了地下室。

sentences.en: They've suffered such days, my children.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们，他们受了这么多苦。
我们听到了巨大的爆炸声。

sentences.en: We hear how people are suffering.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了人们是如何受苦的。

sentences.en: I just kept on myself so that they didn't cry.
sentences.zh: 我一直强忍着，这样他们就不会哭。

sentences.en: When we came from Kiev, I started to cry so that all these tears...
sentences.zh: 当我们从基辅出来时，我开始哭，因为所有的泪水……

sentences.en: When we left, I was trying not to cry in Kiev, but when we left Kiev, I started just crying and the tears wouldn't stop.
sentences.zh: 离开时，我在基辅努力不哭，但当我们离开基辅时，我开始不停地哭，泪水止不住地流。

sentences.en: We really want the Ukrainian army to win, to succeed.
sentences.zh: 我们真心希望乌克兰军队能赢，能成功。

sentences.en: We see how it's so unjust what's happening.
sentences.zh: 我们看到正在发生的一切是多么不公正。

sentences.en: We want the Ukrainian army to win.
sentences.zh: 我们希望乌克兰军队能赢。

sentences.en: So we're going back out of the shelter now, back out of the basement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在要离开避难所，回到地面上。

sentences.en: I guess the danger is over.
What time is it, you guys?
When we got the all clear after about half an hour, the families climbed back up the stairs into their hallways and back rooms and next to the piano.
sentences.zh: 在大约半小时后收到警报解除的通知，家人们爬回楼梯，回到各自的走廊、里屋，还有钢琴旁边。

sentences.en: And we went back to the kindergarten for the night.
sentences.zh: 然后我们回到了幼儿园过夜。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
